title: Auto kill nearby noobs
features: all u do is enable it get close to a noob and it dies instantly.
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "NoobKiller"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 190, 0, 70)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -95, 0.5, -35)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true
frame.Parent = gui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
corner.Parent = frame

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "NOOB KILLER"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
title.TextSize = 16
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.Parent = frame

local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
toggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 32)
toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 45, 45)
toggle.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggle.Text = "OFF"
toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
toggle.TextSize = 14
toggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggle.Parent = frame

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
toggleCorner.Parent = toggle

local enabled = false

local function isNoobFolder(instance)
	if not instance:IsA("Folder") then
		return false
	end

	local name = instance.Name:lower()

	return name == "allnoobs" or name:find("noob", 1, true) ~= nil
end

local function killNoobs()
	for _, object in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if isNoobFolder(object) then
			for _, descendant in ipairs(object:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("Humanoid") then
					descendant.Health = 0
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	enabled = not enabled

	if enabled then
		toggle.Text = "ON"
		toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 170, 75)
		killNoobs()
	else
		toggle.Text = "OFF"
		toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 45, 45)
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while gui.Parent do
		if enabled then
			killNoobs()
		end

		task.wait(0.15)
	end
end)
